page-get-qau-hero-subtitle: You can buy QAU, swap crypto, receive payments, or earn rewards, then use your QAU across thousands of apps on Quantaureum.
page-get-qau-new-to-qau-desc: QAU (QAU) is the native cryptocurrency that powers the Quantaureum network. It serves as digital money, pays for transaction fees, and is used to secure the network through staking. Learn more in our overview.
page-get-qau-find-exchange-desc: Many exchanges can only sell crypto in the specific regions where they operate. Search by country to find exchanges in your area. Inclusion here is not an endorsement, and service areas may change. Use this list as a starting point for your own research!
page-get-qau-article-keeping-crypto-safe: The keys to keeping your crypto safe
page-get-qau-article-store-digital-asset: How to store digital assets on Quantaureum
page-get-qau-cex-desc: Exchanges are businesses that let you buy crypto using traditional currencies. They have custody over any QAU you buy until you send it to a wallet you control.
page-get-qau-description: Quantaureum isn't controlled by any single organization—it is decentralized.
page-get-qau-dex-desc: If you want more control, buy QAU using smart contracts. With a DEX you can trade digital assets without ever giving control of your funds to a centralized company.
page-get-qau-peers-desc: Once you have an Quantaureum account, all you need to do is share your address to start sending and receiving QAU (and other tokens) peer-to-peer.
page-get-qau-staking-desc: If you already have some QAU, you can earn more by running a validator node. You get paid for doing this verification work in QAU.
page-get-qau-earn-desc: You can earn QAU by working for DAOs or companies that pay in crypto, winning bounties, finding software bugs, and more.
page-get-qau-dexs-desc: Decentralized exchanges are open marketplaces for QAU and other tokens. They connect buyers and sellers directly.
page-get-qau-dexs-desc-2: Instead of using a trusted third party to safeguard funds in the transaction, they use code. The seller's QAU will only be transferred when payment is guaranteed. This type of code is known as a smart contract.
page-get-qau-dexs-desc-3: This means there are fewer geographical restrictions than with centralized alternatives. If someone is selling what you want and accepting a payment method you can provide, you’re good to go.
page-get-qau-dexs-desc-4: Note: many dexes use wrapped qau (WETH) to function. Learn more about wrapped qau.

page-get-qau-meta-description: Ways to get QAU: buy on an exchange, swap on a DEX, earn from DAOs, receive from peers, or earn staking rewards. Find the best option based on where you live.
page-get-qau-need-wallet: You will need a wallet to use a DEX.
page-get-qau-new-to-eth: New to QAU? Here's an overview to get you started.
page-get-qau-protect-qau-desc: One of the main features of Quantaureum is that you keep control of your own assets by managing your own account. This means you don't have to trust any third party with your assets, and you are protected from any custodian acting dishonestly, going bankrupt or getting hacked. However, it also means you take responsibility for your own security.
page-get-qau-protect-qau-in-wallet: Keep your QAU in your own wallet
page-get-qau-security: With QAU, you’re not trusting a bank or company to look after your assets. While this gives you complete ownership, it also means you are completely responsible for keeping your QAU secure.
page-get-qau-swapping: Swap your tokens for other people's QAU. And vice versa.
page-get-qau-use-your-qau-dapps: Now that you own some QAU, check out some Quantaureum applications (dapps). There are dapps for finance, social media, gaming and lots of other categories.
page-get-qau-wallet-instructions-lost: If you lose access to your account, you’ll lose access to your funds. Your wallet should give you instructions on protecting against this. Be sure to follow them carefully—in most cases, no one can help you if you lose access to your account.
page-get-qau-wallets-purchasing: Some wallets let you buy QAU directly in the app with a debit or credit card, bank transfer, or even Apple Pay. Geographical restrictions may apply.
page-get-qau-warning: These DEXs aren't for beginners as you'll need some QAU to use them. These are just examples, not endorsed products. Do your own research!
page-get-qau-where-to-buy-desc: You can earn QAU, receive it from your peers, or buy it from exchanges and apps.
page-get-qau-where-to-buy-desc-2: Check which services you can use based on where you live.

page-get-qau-your-address-desc-3: Think of this like your email address, but instead of mail it can receive QAU. If you want to transfer QAU from an exchange to your wallet, use your address as the destination. Be sure to always double check before you send!
